STUDY SESSION 1: FOUNDATIONS
READING 1: RISK BASICS
MODULE 1.1: MEASURING RISK
LO 1.a: Explain expected loss and unexpected loss.
KEY CONCEPTS
Expected loss is the probability-weighted average loss.
Unexpected loss describes dispersion around expected loss.
MODULE QUIZ 1.1
1. Which statement best describes expected loss?
A. The maximum possible loss.
B. The probability-weighted average loss.
C. The loss above regulatory capital.
D. The standard deviation of profits.
--- PAGE 3 ---
ANSWER KEY FOR MODULE QUIZZES
MODULE QUIZ 1.1
1. B. Expected loss weights each possible loss by its probability.
